artists.biography:
David Ryan Adams (born November 5, 1974) is an American alt-country/rock singer-songwriter, from Jacksonville, North Carolina. Adams left the group Whiskeytown and released his first solo album Heartbreaker in 2000. The album was nominated for the Shortlist Music Prize and Adams released six additional solo albums, including the UK certified-gold Gold. He released five albums with the rock band The Cardinals and in 2009 Adams married singer-songwriter and actress Mandy Moore. Adams left The Cardinals and announced that he was taking a break from music. He resumed performing in October 2010 and released his thirteenth studio album, Ashes & Fire, on October 11, 2011. The album peaked at No. 7 on the Billboard 200.
Adams has also produced albums for Jesse Malin and Willie Nelson and collaborated with Counting Crows, Weezer, Norah Jones, America, Minnie Driver, Cowboy Junkies, Leona Naess, Toots & the Maytals, Beth Orton and Krista Polvere. He has written a book of poems, Infinity Blues, and Hello Sunshine, a collection of poems and short stories.

perplexity.description:
Released in 2001 on Lost Highway Records, Gold is the second studio album by Ryan Adams and stands as a pivotal work in his discography. Marking a departure from the more downbeat, country-leaning sound of his earlier releases, Gold embraces a broader rock palette, incorporating elements of classic rock, power pop, and 1960s soul. The album features a dynamic range of styles, from the anthemic, Pete Townshend-inspired opening track "New York, New York" to the upbeat harmonica-driven "Firecracker" and the introspective ballad "When the Stars Go Blue." This stylistic expansion signaled Adams' ambition to craft a modern classic, blending heartfelt songwriting with accessible melodies.

Gold became Ryan Adams' best-selling album, achieving Gold certification in the UK and selling over 800,000 copies worldwide. It earned critical acclaim and two Grammy nominations in 2002: Best Male Rock Vocal Performance for "New York, New York" and Best Rock Album. The album's success solidified Adams' reputation as a leading figure in the alt-country and rock scenes, while its enduring popularity is reflected in the numerous covers of its songs by artists such as The Corrs and Tim McGraw.
